text:
anthea: Quick heads-up — onboarding partner hit a flaky bug in nextjs-llamaindex-starter: duplicate embedding/callouts when auth refresh triggers SDK retry. Seen in local dev and CI.

marco: ugh. how to repro?

anthea: steps:
1) run starter in edge dev mode
2) call /api/embed with an expired token
3) client retries, but serving logs show two POST /v1/embeddings for the same input
4) eval harness counts double embeddings and marks the run flaky

marco: paste the client call?

anthea:```js
// simplified client snippet
await rwClient.embeddings.create({
  model: 'open-lite-embed',
  input: ['doc text'],
  retry: { max: 2, backoff: 100 }
})
```

devon: this matches the SDK-parity gap we've seen: Node SDK auto-injects an idempotency header on retries (x-idempotency-key); edge/browser client doesn't yet. Runtime treats retries as new requests -> duplicate upstream work. Streaming/embeds/agent tool calls can all trigger this.

marco: short-term fix: change starter to generate a single id per user-request and attach `x-rw-idempotency` header, reusing across retries. That prevents the inflight marker from missing the retry.

anthea: tried that locally — it eliminated the duplicate POSTs in the serving console. I also added a tiny e2e that mocks a 401 then 200 and asserts a single upstream POST.

ci-bot: ci: 2 failing eval runs for branch next-llama-embed-retry. See https://ci.internal.redwood/evals/2766 (truncated).

devon: long-term options: (A) ship SDK parity so edge client sets the idempotency header like Node; (B) runtime: include an idempotency header in the KV inflight fingerprint when present; (C) starter-layer: attach runId to agent/tool calls to make replays detectable.

marco: can we standardize on a dedicated header like `x-rw-idempotency` so runtime can safely read it without exposing general headers?

devon: yes, runtime team is ok with a dedicated header. We'll coordinate on the header name and add a small backwards-compatible check. I'll also add telemetry metric `inflight.duplicate_detected` to monitor regressions.

anthea: i'll open a PR to: 1) add the header to the starter samples, 2) add tests in `tests/retry-embed.spec.ts`, and 3) update README with a short workaround note until SDK parity lands.

marco: please tag me on the PR. once the SDK change lands we can remove the temp workaround.

anthea: thanks — sending PR shortly. :rocket:

sdk-bot: note: added task EDGE-RETRY-IDEMP to SDK board for parity work.

marco: nice. good triage everyone — this should cut down flakes in evals and demos.
